name: s81svc_irg_hsfp

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered: ot_s81_svc_idx_hslice_fp flops every input at the pin (pin flop) and every output leaves a flop (q / key 2 edges pin to pin); the chunk schedule (cs_out = key_in + LAT_T + FPL + 2 + FPL*hid) is priced on those edges, a recipe pin stage would shift it.

why_floorplan: DIE-S81-85 svc provider form A, svc_lo fallback (b) IRG box (COORD 11-09 native-census decision): 77.76 x 276.48 exact (the band height), fill 0.399; the 8 slices of a chunk abut W->E at 86.4 pitch (8.64 seams), so the chain faces are W (ql / k_key / cs_in) and E (qo / ko_key / cs_out); clk / rst_n / hid / first straps from the chunk relay on N.  Census: drivers > 64 loads fixed structurally (q_we / pos_r kept copies, adder swap select SWREP 4, adder data cuts DRST 0 so the reset relay drives only valid bits); 33-64 load drivers stay (COORD loopgap-153x-1109 census exception, sign-off STA / slew decides).

job.purpose: DIE-S81-85 svc provider form A: IRG fastpad hslice (ot_s81_svc_idx_hslice_fp) pilot kit, fallback (b) 77.76 box at fill 0.399, 32 per svc_lo type
